parameters.query: INSERT INTO projects (project_id, client_name, project_name, project_value, complexity, phases, total_duration_weeks, project_start, estimated_completion, team_size, status, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.project_id }}', '{{ $json.client_name }}', '{{ $json.project_name }}', {{ $json.project_value }}, '{{ $json.complexity }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.phases) }}', {{ $json.total_duration_weeks }}, '{{ $json.project_start }}', '{{ $json.estimated_completion }}', {{ $json.team_size }}, 'active', NOW()) RETURNING id

parameters.subject: 🚀 Project Kickoff - {{ $node['Create Project Structure'].json['project_name'] }}
parameters.message:
Hi {{ $node['Project Contract Signed'].json['contact_name'] }},

Exciting news! Your automation project is officially underway. Here's your project overview:

📋 Project Details:
• Project: {{ $node['Create Project Structure'].json['project_name'] }}
• Timeline: {{ $node['Create Project Structure'].json['total_duration_weeks'] }} weeks
• Estimated Completion: {{ new Date($node['Create Project Structure'].json['estimated_completion']).toLocaleDateString() }}
• Team Size: {{ $node['Create Project Structure'].json['team_size'] }} specialists

🗓️ Project Phases:
{{ Object.entries($node['Create Project Structure'].json['phases']).map(([id, phase]) => `• ${phase.name} (${phase.duration_weeks} weeks)`).join('\n') }}

👥 Your Project Team:
{{ Object.values($node['Assign Project Team'].json['team_assignments']).map(member => `• ${member.name} - ${member.role}`).join('\n') }}

Thank you for choosing us for your automation journey!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Project Director

parameters.query: UPDATE projects SET current_phase = '{{ $json.phase_name }}', phase_completion = {{ $json.completion_percentage }}, last_updated = NOW() WHERE project_id = '{{ $json.project_id }}'

values.content: You are creating a professional phase completion report for a client. Include accomplishments, deliverables, key findings, next steps, and any recommendations. Make it clear and executive-friendly.

parameters.query: SELECT p.*, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - p.project_start)) / 86400 as actual_duration_days, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_feedback WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND rating >= 4) as positive_feedback_count FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = '{{ $json.project_id }}'

values.content: Create a compelling case study/success story for a completed automation project. Include the challenge, solution, results, and client testimonial. Make it suitable for marketing materials.
